title: ToxiLab: How Well Do Open-Source LLMs Generate Synthetic Toxicity Data?
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the generation of synthetic hate speech, which includes content targeting groups based on religion, among other characteristics like race, ethnicity, and gender.
findings: The study's findings on generating synthetic hate speech apply to religion as a sub-category. It found that fine-tuned open-source models, particularly Mistral, can effectively generate diverse and high-quality toxic data, including hate speech targeting religious groups, thereby improving detection models. However, prompt-based generation alone is often insufficient due to models' inherent safety alignments.
